questions.question_delta: MATERIAL NARROWING, not a rewording. March asks what steps should be initiated and who should initiate them. July asks what steps should be initiated BY THE COASTAL STATE and who is responsible for initiating them. July also prints "Indian-flagged" where March prints "Indian flag". An answer reused from March must be re-pointed at coastal-state powers and duties; flag-state material that satisfies March does not, on its own, satisfy July. The source copy itself prints the March wording beneath the July question under a host "PROVIOUSLY ASKED" heading.

notes: This sitting predates 15 March 2026, when the Merchant Shipping Act, 2025 commenced and repealed the Merchant Shipping Act, 1958 by s.324(1). The answer is governed by the 1958 Act as it stood at the sitting. Reusing a 2026 object that was re-anchored onto the 2025 Act is a statute regression and must be re-authored back onto the 1958 Act. The April 2026 sweep found the 1958 Act asserted on eight separate surfaces of a single question object - model answer, study guide, recall_15s, major_trap, an answer_route core point, a retrieval card, regulations and search_aliases. Expect eight again, in reverse.
